name: Shanghai Iluvatar Corex
summary: Aartech Solonics Ltd. is a research and development company that creates system solutions and specialized energy devices. Products include the BTS 2000 fast bus transfer system, FaraDigm, control relay panels and load checkers. Anil Anant Raje founded it on August 24, 1982, and its main office is in Bhopal, India.
